study.title: NBA momentum measures study: do momentum measures on team stats predict the next 5-10 games beyond team strength?
study.holdout: 2026-27 regular season to date; scored once after every choice was fixed
protocol: Leave-one-season-out over 2018-19 to 2025-26 with pooled out-of-fold predictions
Paired bootstrap, 2000 resamples of whole team-seasons (next-10 targets overlap from game to game)
Baseline: Elo after the game plus season-to-date net rating; candidates scored on what they add
Every feature uses only the team's earlier games; cross-team z-scores per date use each team's latest state on or before that date
No imputation; missing values are counted per feature
Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate across the 154 features per target (q < 0.05)
Nested combination search: top 6 series x top 6 measures ranked on training seasons only, 400 combinations x 3 ridge penalties chosen by inner leave-one-season-out
Permutation baseline: 200 reruns of the whole nested search with the target shuffled among teams within each date

seeds.bootstrap: STUDY_SEED + number of seasons in the run

targets.definition: Mean over the team's next 10 games of (point margin minus the margin Elo expected), the expectation using the team's Elo after game k, the opponent's pregame Elo and home court: (Elo - opp Elo + 100 x home sign) / 28 points.
Same as net10_beyond_elo over the next 5 games.
Mean opponent-adjusted offensive rating over the next 10 games (points per 100 possessions minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed).
Mean opponent-adjusted defensive rating over the next 10 games (points allowed per 100 possessions minus the opponent's season-to-date average scored); lower is better.
Win share over the next 10 games minus the mean Elo win probability for those games (team Elo after game k).
Next game won by the home side (one row per game), logistic model on the pregame Elo difference with home court plus the season-to-date net-rating difference; scored by log loss and ROC-AUC.

measures.name: ROC-10
measures.forward_only_definition: Elo: (Elo after game k - Elo 10 games earlier) / 10. Box series: mean of the last 10 games minus the mean of the team's games before them (at least 5 earlier games). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: MACD
measures.forward_only_definition: Exponentially weighted mean of the series with span 5 minus the same with span 15, updated game by game from the season's first game. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: Velocity
measures.forward_only_definition: Slope of a least-squares line through the trailing 10 games of the series. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: Acceleration
measures.forward_only_definition: Velocity after game k minus velocity after game k-5. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: EWMA of changes
measures.forward_only_definition: Exponentially weighted mean (span 5) of the per-game change (Elo) or surprise (box series: game value minus the team's own mean of its earlier games). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: Z-score
measures.forward_only_definition: ROC-10 divided by the standard deviation of the team's changes or surprises in games 1..k (expanding window). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: RSI
measures.forward_only_definition: Over the last 10 changes or surprises: 100 x average gain / (average gain + average loss); recent gains vs losses on a 0-100 scale. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: Growth difference
measures.forward_only_definition: Sum of the last 10 changes or surprises minus the sum of the 10 before them (a difference, because the ratio is unstable near zero). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: Kalman slope
measures.forward_only_definition: Filtered slope of a local linear trend model (level + slope + noise) run forward through games 1..k; its three noise variances are fitted by maximum likelihood on the training seasons only. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: Streak
measures.forward_only_definition: Signed length of the current run: wins/losses for Elo, positive/negative surprises for box series. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

measures.name: Impulse
measures.forward_only_definition: m[k] = 0.85 x m[k-1] + change or surprise in game k, from the season's first game. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the 10th game.

series.name: Elo rating
series.definition: Shared Elo rating after each game (R/elo.R: K 20, home court 100, margin-of-victory multiplier, 0.75 season carry-over).

series.name: Point margin
series.definition: Point margin minus the opponent's season-to-date average margin allowed (earlier games only).

series.name: Offensive rating
series.definition: Points per 100 possessions minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Defensive rating
series.definition: Points allowed per 100 possessions minus the opponent's season-to-date average scored.

series.name: Net rating
series.definition: Net rating (ORtg - DRtg) minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Pace (possessions)
series.definition: Possessions (FGA - ORB + TOV + 0.44 x FTA, both teams averaged) minus the opponent's season-to-date average.

series.name: Effective FG%
series.definition: Effective FG% minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Turnover %
series.definition: Turnover % minus the opponent's season-to-date average forced.

series.name: Offensive rebound %
series.definition: Offensive rebound % minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Free-throw rate
series.definition: FTA/FGA minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Effective FG% allowed
series.definition: Effective FG% allowed minus the opponent's season-to-date average.

series.name: Turnover % forced
series.definition: Turnover % forced minus the opponent's season-to-date average committed.

series.name: Offensive rebound % allowed
series.definition: Offensive rebound % allowed minus the opponent's season-to-date average.

series.name: Free-throw rate allowed
series.definition: FTA/FGA allowed minus the opponent's season-to-date average.

limits: Effects are small: regression to the mean dominates NBA results over 5-10 games.
The combination search uses rows where all 154 features exist (from about a team's 21st game) so every candidate is scored on the same rows; single features use all rows where they exist.
Kalman variances are fitted on the outer training seasons and reused in the inner loop.
Bootstrap intervals for the incremental IC hold the ranks at their full-sample values.
The next-game target is scored by log loss; its ROC-AUC change is a point estimate without an interval.
The board residual exists only for 2026-27 (190 of 258 games with a resolved logged pregame margin); its check is in-sample and small.
2026-27 is early: teams have played too few games for most holdout rows (features need 10 games, targets 5 or 10 later games).
Possession estimates and four-factor rates are noisy over 5-10 games.
The Elo-expectation residual proxy for part B was not run.
